headline: Found the real bug — the plugin never ran on your 5.1 receiver
note: The whole time, the plugin was skipping your surround receiver because it told Windows it only handled 2 channels. That's why nothing you touched did anything on the receiver. Fixed and measured: it now locks at 6 channels and your controls reach it — Bass +2.70 dB at 60 Hz, volume 0/-10/-30 exact, upmix now spreads stereo across the surrounds (+8.53 dB delta inside the plugin). Also fixed: two copies of the app running at once (a real cause of 'controls do nothing'), and the app no longer mentions the cable you deleted.
updated: surround + single-instance + upmix fixes, all pushed

items.text: Plugin now runs on the 5.1 receiver (was stereo-only)
Root cause: it reported 2 channels before locking, so Windows skipped it
App controls reach the receiver - Bass +2.70 dB measured
Upmix spreads stereo to surrounds (+8.53 dB inside the plugin)
Single-instance guard - two copies were overwriting each other
No more mention of the cable you removed
Built a loopback analyzer and session lister for real measurement
Learned: loopback taps before the plugin - use its own stats log
App reset to neutral, one instance, plugin attached
For you to confirm by ear: does 5.1 fill all speakers now
